name: form-field
title: Form field
description: A control with its words: a label above or beside it (with an optional or required mark, and the changed mark), a description, a readback of what was understood, and an error that grows open from under the control on the settle spring; invalid and disabled reach every control inside. Fieldset groups fields under a legend. ChangedMark is shared with other controls.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/form-field.md. SwiftUI: MetalFormField, MetalFieldset, MetalChangedMark in the MetalUI Swift package.
